summary: Describes TinyMT32, a pseudorandom number generator that produces 32-bit unsigned integers and is a small variant of the Mersenne Twister. Its small state suits embedded devices and it is simple and deterministic. It is not meant for cryptographic use.

eli5.summary: It is a tiny dice-rolling machine that gives the same rolls from the same start, so two computers can follow along together. It is not safe for secrets.
